snippet.title: Direlands: Extraction - The Story
snippet.description:
Direlands: Extraction is a spellcasting extraction RPG inspired by games of old. You delve into the zones of the Direlands — the drifting fragments of a world that was shattered long ago — working to find a way to reconnect the fragments of Aurelanth once again. Access is only temporary: the rift becomes unstable and closes. Find what you can, then get out before it does — or lose it all.

🔷 Wishlist on Steam → https://store.steampowered.com/app/4726670/
🔷 Join the Discord → https://discord.gg/kBNaEYjZY

CHAPTERS
0:00 Ash Intro
0:15 A World That Did Not Fear Death
0:54 Something Saw the Light 
1:28 The Shattering 
2:32 The Long Silence 
3:32 You
